## Your Submission

**What I Built:**
I created a F!rosh Week schedule that toggles between Day and Nite events. I think it's a fun, interactive way to display the timetable, and this format allowed me to leverage the F!rosh color palette to visually separate Nitelife from other events.

**Challenges I Faced:**
Parsing the JSON file was a little tricky, as I always find strings finicky to work with. Additionally, the logic behind displaying the schedule in two parts was more troublesome than expected.

**What I'm Most Proud Of:**
I'm especially proud of the sun/moon CSS animation; it's a small way to add more polish and cohesion to the page, and I think it ties the theming together quite nicely. Also, I hadn't done pure CSS animation before, but it was very enjoyable to learn.

**Tools Used:** ChatGPT 4o

**How I Used Them:**
After mocking up the page in Figma, I had ChatGPT generate the initial HTML and CSS per the layout I designed. I also used it to resolve syntactical errors in my code, especially when parsing the schedule data.

**What I Reviewed / Changed After:**
The output didn't entirely match the mockup I provided, so I reworked portions of it before moving on to implementing the remaining components.

**Reflection:**
The code generated by AI highlighted the coding conventions I was not following, which pushed me to make my code more organized. It also showed me how to tie CSS, HTML, and React elements together more coherently. The parts I wrote without AI built on what I already knew, or were amalgamations of open-source code from online, which showed me new techniques and tricks.
